name: LulzSec
description: LulzSec (Lulz Security) was a hacktivist group that spun off from Anonymous in May 2011, responsible for high-profile attacks on Sony PlayStation Network, the CIA website, the FBI, and the US Senate during a 50-day hacking spree. The group disbanded in June 2011 after several members were identified. Co-founder Hector 'Sabu' Monsegur cooperated with the FBI, leading to the arrest of five core members in 2012.
